author: LGR
description:
Unboxing and setting up an Easy-Bake Kitchen CD-ROM game! I've always found these late 90s keyboard attachments rather charming and this virtual Easy Bake Oven experience takes the cake in being the most oddly alluring. It also has become rather searched for online, so when I recently ran across it in storage I decided it needed featuring on LGR. Also you can use it to play Doom so that's enough for me.
